CORPORATE PROFILE
公司簡介

China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited (the “Company”; stock code: 2319) and its
subsidiaries (the “Group” or “Mengniu”) manufacture and distribute quality dairy products
in China. It is one of the leading dairy product manufacturers in China, with MENGNIU
as its core brand. Mengniu’s diversified products include liquid milk (such as UHT milk,
milk beverages and yogurt), ice cream, milk formula and other products (such as plant-
based protein beverage and cheese). Mengniu made it on the “Global Dairy Top 20” list
published by Rabobank, placing itself among the top 10 of dairy industry in 2017 and 2018
consecutively. By the end of December 2018, the Group’s annual production capacity of
dairy products reached 9.75 million tons. In March 2014, Mengniu became a Hang Seng
Index constituent, making it the first blue chip Chinese dairy product enterprise.

中國蒙牛乳業有限公司（「本公司」；股份代號：2319）及其子公司（統稱「本集團」或「蒙
牛」
 ）於中國生產及銷售優質乳製品。憑藉其主要品牌蒙牛 ，蒙牛已成為中國領先的乳製品
生產商之一。蒙牛提供多元化的產品，包括液態奶 （如UHT奶、乳飲料及酸奶） 、冰淇淋、
奶粉及其他產品（如植物蛋白飲品、奶酪）。蒙牛於二零一七年及二零一八年連續兩年於荷
蘭合作銀行公佈的「全球乳業20強」佔據全球首十名。截至二零一八年十二月底，本集團
乳製品的全年生產能力達975萬噸。二零一四年三月，蒙牛獲納入恒生指數成份股，成為
首家中國乳製品企業藍籌股。

   Amendments to IFRS 3 clarify and provide additional                   國際財務報告準則第3號的修訂澄清並提供
   guidance on the definition of a business. The amendments              有關業務定義的額外指引。該項修訂澄清，
   clarify that for an integrated set of activities and assets to        一組綜合活動及資產須至少包括一項參數與
   be considered a business, it must include, at a minimum, an           一個重要過程共同對創造收益的能力作出重
   input and a substantive process that together significantly           大貢獻，方能被視為一項業務。在並未包含
   contribute to the ability to create output. A business can exist      所有創造收益的參數及過程的情況下，業務
   without including all of the inputs and processes needed to           亦可存續。該項修訂取消對市場參與者是否
   create outputs. The amendments remove the assessment                  具備能力收購業務及持續產生收益進行的評
   of whether market participants are capable of acquiring the           估，相反，重點放在已取得參數及已取得重
   business and continue to produce outputs. Instead, the                要過程能否共同對創造收益的能力作出重大
   focus is on whether acquired inputs and acquired substantive          貢獻。該項修訂亦收窄收益的定義，聚焦向
   processes together significantly contribute to the ability to         客戶提供的貨品或服務、投資收入或來自日
   create outputs. The amendments have also narrowed the                 常活動的其他收入。此外，該項修訂提供有
   definition of outputs to focus on goods or services provided to       關評估已取得過程是否屬重大的指引，並引
   customers, investment income or other income from ordinary            入選擇性公允值集中度測試，允許對一組已
   activities. Furthermore, the amendments provide guidance              收購活動及資產是否屬一項業務進行簡單評
   to assess whether an acquired process is substantive and              估。本集團預期自二零二零年一月一日起採
   introduce an optional fair value concentration test to permit a       納該項修訂。
   simplified assessment of whether an acquired set of activities
   and assets is not a business. The Group expects to adopt the
   amendments prospectively from 1 January 2020.

   Amendments to IFRS 10 and IAS 28 address an                           國際財務報告準則第10號及國際會計準則第
   inconsistency between the requirements in IFRS 10 and                 28號的修訂針對國際財務報告準則第10號
   in IAS 28 in dealing with the sale or contribution of assets          及國際會計準則第28號之間有關投資者與其
   between an investor and its associate or joint venture. The           聯營公司或合營企業之間的資產出售或注資
   amendments require a full recognition of a gain or loss when          兩者規定的不一致性。該等修訂規定，當投
   the sale or contribution of assets between an investor and            資者與其聯營公司或合營企業之間的資產出
   its associate or joint venture constitutes a business. For a          售或注資構成一項業務時，須確認全數收益
   transaction involving assets that do not constitute a business,       或虧損。當交易涉及不構成一項業務的資產
   a gain or loss resulting from the transaction is recognised in        時，由該交易產生的收益或虧損於該投資者
   the investor’s profit or loss only to the extent of the unrelated     的損益內確認，惟僅以不相關投資者於該聯
   investor’s interest in that associate or joint venture. The           營公司或合營企業的權益為限。該等修訂即
   amendments are to be applied prospectively. The previous              將應用。國際會計準則理事會已於二零一五

2.4 SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT                                                2.4 重大會計政策概要
    ACCOUNTING POLICIES
     Investments in associates and joint ventures                           投資聯營公司及合營企業
     An associate is an entity in which the Group has a long term           聯營公司指本集團持有其一般不少於20%
     interest of generally not less than 20% of the equity voting           投票權的長期權益而對其有重要影響力的公
     rights and over which it is in a position to exercise significant      司。重大影響力為可參與被投資對象的財政
     influence. Significant influence is the power to participate in        及營運政策決定而非對該等政策施加控制或
     the financial and operating policy decisions of the investee,          共同控制。
     but is not control or joint control over those policies.

     A joint venture is a type of joint arrangement whereby the             合營企業屬共同安排，據此，擁有該安排共
     parties that have joint control of the arrangement have rights         同控制權的訂約方有權享有合營企業的資產
     to the net assets of the joint venture. Joint control is the           淨值。共同控制權指按照合約協定對一項安
     contractually agreed sharing of control of an arrangement,             排所共有的控制權，僅在相關活動必須獲得
     which exists only when decisions about the relevant activities         共同享有控制權的各方一致同意方能決定時
     require the unanimous consent of the parties sharing control.          存在。

     The Group’s investments in associates and joint ventures are           本集團於聯營公司及合營企業的投資乃採用
     stated in the consolidated statement of financial position at          權益會計法按本集團所佔資產淨值減任何減
     the Group’s share of net assets under the equity method of             值損失於綜合財務狀況表列賬。
     accounting, less any impairment losses.

     is lower than the fair value of the net assets acquired, the           差額於損益表確認為議價購入的收益。
     difference is, after reassessment, recognised in profit or loss as
     a gain on bargain purchase.

   an approximation of the original effective interest rate. The           現金流量將包括來自銷售所持有抵押品或其

   to the contractual terms.

   since initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses          信貸虧損就可能於未來12個月內出現的違約

   12-months (a 12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for              自初始確認後有顯著增加的信貸風險，須在

   initial recognition, a loss allowance is required for credit losses     論違約事件於何時發生（存續期預期信貸虧
   expected over the remaining life of the exposure, irrespective          損）。
   of the timing of the default (a lifetime ECL).

     reporting period adjusted with reference to the species, age,            成本及預期產奶量作出調整，以反映乳牛的
     growing condition, costs incurred and expected yield of the              不同特點及╱或生長階段；或如沒有市場定
     milk to reflect differences in characteristics and/or stages of          價，則以來自乳牛的按現行市場利率貼現的
     growth of the dairy cows; or the present value of expected               預期現金流量淨額的現值；或在適當情況下
     net cash flows from the dairy cows discounted at a current               按成本釐定。任何估計變動均可能顯著影響
     market-determined rate, when market-determined prices                    乳牛的公允值。獨立合資格專業估值師及管
     are unavailable; or the cost when appropriate. Any change                理層定期複核各項假設及估計，以識別乳牛
     in the estimates may affect the fair value of the dairy cows             公允值的任何重大變動。所用假設詳情披露

     in China Modern Dairy. Taking into account these factors,           交易完成後，本集團對中國現代牧業並無控

     The fair value of the financial assets and liabilities is the          金融資產及負債的公允值為市場參與者於現
     amount at which the asset could be sold and the liability              時進行的交易（強迫或清算銷售除外）中可出
     transferred in a current transaction between market                    售資產及轉讓負債的金額。
     participants, other than in a forced or liquidation sale.

     The following methods and assumptions were used to estimate            下文載列用於估計公允值的方法及假設：
     the fair values:

     The fair values of cash and cash equivalents, the current              現金及現金等價物、保證金存款的即期部
     portion of pledged deposits, trade and bills receivables, trade        分、應收賬款及票據、應付賬款及票據、計
     and bills payables, financial assets included in prepayments,          入預付款、其他應收款項及其他資產的金融
     other receivables and other assets, financial liabilities included     資產、計入其他應付款項及預提費用的金融
     in other payables and accruals, current interest-bearing bank          負債、流動計息銀行貸款及其他貸款的公允
     loans and other loans approximate to their carrying amounts            值因短期內到期而與其賬面值相若。
     largely due to the short term maturities of these instruments.

     The fair values of the non-current portion of other financial          其他金融資產的非流動部分、長期定期存
     assets, long term time deposits, long term receivable, the             款、長期應收款項、計息銀行貸款及長期應
     non-current portion of interest-bearing bank loans and long            付款項的非流動部分以及其他非流動金融負
     term payables and other non-current financial liabilities have         債的公允值乃採用類似條款、信貸風險及餘
     been calculated by discounting the expected future cash                下到期日的工具現時可獲得的利率折現預期
     flows using rates currently available for instruments with             未來現金流量的方式計算。其他借貸的公允
     similar terms, credit risk and remaining maturities. The fair          值乃使用估值技術方法及經參考報價計量。
     values of other borrowings are measured using valuation                可換股承兌票據的公允值乃使用估值技術方
     technical methods and by reference to quoted prices. The fair          法計量。
     value of the convertible promissory note is measured using
     valuation technical methods.

     The fair values of listed equity investments are based on              上市股本投資的公允值乃基於市場報價。
     quoted market prices.

51. FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                51. 財務風險管理目標及政策
    OBJECTIVES AND POLICIES
     Financial risk management                                                 財務風險管理
     The Group’s principal financial instruments, other than                   本集團的主要金融工具（衍生工具除外）包
     derivatives, comprise cash and cash equivalents, trade                    括現金及現金等價物、應收及應付賬款及票
     and bills receivables and payables, other receivables and                 據、其他應收及應付款項、與關聯人士的長
     payables, long term receivables balances with related parties,            期應收結餘、計息銀行及其他借貸、其他貸
     interest-bearing bank and other borrowings, other loans and               款及長期應付款項。該等金融工具旨在為本
     long term payables. The main purpose of these financial                   集團的營運籌集資金。本集團擁有各式各樣
     instruments is to raise finance for the Group’s operations. The           直接來自其業務的其他金融資產及負債，例
     Group has various other financial assets and liabilities such             如應收賬款及應付賬款。
     as trade receivables and trade payables, which arise directly
     from its operations.

     The Group also entered into derivative transactions, mainly               本集團亦訂立衍生交易，主要為商品期貨合
     commodity futures contracts, interest rate swaps, forward                 約、利率互換合約、遠期貨幣合約及利率遠
     currency contracts and interest rate forward contracts. The               期合約，目的為管理本集團業務所產生的商
     purpose is to manage the commodity risk, the exchange                     品風險、匯率及浮動利率風險。
     rate and floating rate exposures arising from the Group’s
     operations.

     The main risks arising from the Group’s financial instruments             來自本集團金融工具的主要風險有利率風
     are interest rate risk, foreign currency risk, credit risk, liquidity     險、外幣風險、信貸風險、流動性風險及股

     The primary objectives of the Group’s capital management           本集團資本管理的基本目標乃維持本集團持

     The Group manages its capital structure and makes                  本集團管理其資本架構，並因應經濟環境的

     in the objectives, policies or processes for managing capital      理的目標、政策或程序並無變動。
     during the years ended 31 December 2018 and 31 December
     2017.

     The Group monitors capital using a gearing ratio, which is net     本集團以資本負債比率監控資本，資本負債

     payables and other financial liabilities, less cash and bank       他貸款、長期應付款項，以及其他金融負
     balances and long term time deposits, and excludes disposal        債，減現金及銀行結存及長期定期存款，並
     groups. Capital represents equity attributable to owners of        不包括處置組。資本指本公司擁有人應佔權
